s_warn_reset: clear warnings after the last step: {state}
panel_intro: Aegis posts punishments, list changes, admin and security events and setting changes to a channel or group you choose.
set_prompt: Pick the log channel or group with the buttons below (Aegis must already be there — in a channel as an admin who can post), forward a post from the channel, or send its @username or -100… id.
set_bad: I couldn't find a chat in that. Use the buttons, forward a post, or send @username or the -100… id — or /cancel.
same_chat: The log chat must be a different chat than the group itself.
bot_not_there: Aegis isn't in that chat, or can't post there. Add it first, then try again.
bot_cant_post_channel: Aegis must be an admin of that channel with «Post messages».
not_admin_there: You must be an admin of that chat to send logs there.
connected: ✅ This chat now receives Aegis's logs for {title}.
test_failed: Couldn't post in the log chat. Check that Aegis is still there and may post.
lock_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — would have acted on a message of {user}: {locks}
lock_bots_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — would have removed {bots}, added by {user}
